body: Replying sa optimism ng headline: this moved me more than a single PMI print because orders, exports, hiring at backlogs are moving together. Pero hindi pa ako bibili ng ‘new industrial supercycle’ T-shirt. Survey breadth is a leading signal, not production volume. Ang clean confirmation: official output/machinery orders follow through AND September-October orders stay broad beyond AI/chips. Until then: stronger pattern, still probationary.
